loci.rationale: Form renders only purpose-relevant inputs: email (delivery), amount and term (offer), income band (assessment), plus the 'auto' route checkbox; no hobby or other non-purpose field is collected.
Entrypoint parses the /apply form payload into data (bounded field count, single values) and passes it to store.submit; no extra fields are synthesized.
Route /apply forwards the accepted payload to store.submit, the sole persistence path for applications.
Server-side allowlist rejects any application field outside {email, amount, term, income, auto}, enforcing minimization on the accepted payload.
Validation bounds amount, term and income band to defined values so only purpose-relevant, constrained data proceeds.
Persistence writes only email, amount, term, income, route, stage; summary title uses amount and term only — no non-purpose field stored.
Onward payloads: offer() sends email, amount, term; portable() sends email, amount, term, income — all purpose-relevant, no hobby.
Transfer stores the portable payload (email, amount, term, income) in receiver, confirming onward sending is limited to purpose-relevant fields.

output.path_summary: Customer dashboard form (views.py 31-32) collects only email, amount, term, income and the 'auto' route choice. POST /apply (app.py 53-55, 83-84) parses the form and calls store.submit, which enforces a field allowlist (store.py 67), validates amount/term/income (69-74), and persists only purpose-relevant columns (77-79). Onward payloads — offer (111-112), portable (114-116) and transfer to receiver (201-203) — carry only email, amount, term, income. No hobby or other non-purpose field appears in the form, allowlist, schema, or onward payloads, so the minimization predicate holds.
missing_boundaries: No execution, repository or external retrieval was performed; assessment is limited to the supplied snapshot.
Legal sufficiency of the 'auto' consent/route checkbox is not assessed; it is treated as a route control, not an extra data field.
Other GDPR obligations (retention, consent validity, security) are out of scope for this predicate.
No inference about upstream or hidden implementation beyond the supplied files.
